I liked the skin cream so much that I decided to give the eye cream a shot, and I'm glad I did!  The consistency is super light and nongreasy. It works as stated! I have been using this product for almost a month and I am very happy with the results. I have tried more expensive products that I have purchased from fine departments stores before and this product works faster and better!

I have been using this eye cream for the last month.  It has been very helpful in removing puffiness and dark circles from beneath my eyes.  A very small amount goes a long way.  It is non-greasy and absorbs easily and quickly into the skin.  It has been a great help especially on those mornings when I wasn't able to get enough sleep!

This stuff feels great on the skin! I didn't notice a big difference the first two times using it. But after a week or so, my skin just looks less tired, brighter, and just overall more healthy. The wrinkles and puffiness have definitely gone down. I'm not sure how much of a difference other people can tell, as I didn't have a HUGE problem to begin with. But I can definitely tell that a few subtle improvements make a big difference for me and it looks and feels great!

reviews.t: Keshima eye gel is simply amazing. A small pea size amount leaves your eyes ...
reviews.x: Keshima eye gel is simply amazing.  A small pea size amount leaves your eyes feeling refreshed and awake.  I have been using the product for over a week now and tell a huge difference in the fine lines around my eyes.  I look younger and more radiant.  I leaves my eyes feeling refreshed and hydrated like I've just had a facial..  I am extremely happy with this purchase and will continue to use Keshima eye gel.

I ordered this gel for my mom and has been using it for several days. So far she has indicated she has noticed a decrease in her eye puffiness and is very happy with this product. It comes in an easy to use dispenser. She is using it twice a day as instructed.

reviews.x: It actually helps the puffiness. Dab on the eye area and let it dry. It only takes couple of minutes to work.

I am 59 y/o and recently developed pale skin around my eyes after a major surgery that resulted with low iron and low blood counts.  This serum did exactly what it said it would. My skin appears healthier. It is soft and brighter around my eyes. I also take vitamin and mineral supplement daily that targets my skin in general. After  a few weeks I definitely noticed a difference (I'd been taking pictures) in that I didn't look as tired or run-down. While the gel didn't entirely take away the lines or dark circles, it helped them from worsening and improved them a bit. I'll definitely keep using this and see how another few weeks/months work out!

reviews.t: Helps with the appeance of my wrinkles and puffiness around my eyes
reviews.x: I like this eye gel, it does help with the appearance of the wrinkles and crows feet around my eyes.  It goes on smoothly and absorbs into my skin quickly, and there is no redness or irritation at all.  I use it morning after washing my face and again before I go to bed. It relieves the puffiness that I get around my eyes sometimes too.  It does make the area around my eyes look younger.  I'm happy with this purchase.

So live this product.  I use it daily and have purchased it twice now.  It has improved the lines around my eyes and face. I have had so many compliments about my skin. People are shocked to hear my age. I recommend this product!!

This is a product that you put on in the morning under your makeup. It's not a night cream. It works well. I have puffy eyes from allergies and this helps. It also tightens up my skin so wrinkles are not so prevalent. My only complaint is that it is a pump and it puts out too much product for me. I'd prefer to squeeze out exactly how much I need.

reviews.x: This eye gel has a different feel than the ones that I have been using.  It goes on smoothly and doesn't leave any kind of a "lotion" feel behind, which is great. I have not noticed a big difference in my eye appearance, but I have only been using for 10 days, I feel that after 30 days or 60 days, I will most likely see a difference.

reviews.t: It is cool and the gel feels great on my eye
reviews.x: I've used many different eye gels and this one really stood out. I noticed a difference the first day I used it. It is cool and the gel feels great on my eye. I struggle with an auto immune illness and my eyes show my fatigue. I have had several compliments on how bright my eyes are and I know its because the puffiness is less noticeable.

I have only been using this for a few weeks, but so far so good. It is a gel that goes on really nicely, dries instantly, and isn't greasy. I think it works as well as or better than other eye creams I have tried for wrinkles. It doesn't seem to do much for dark circles. It's definitely better than what you would expect for the price.

. I have used this product before, mainly for puffiness.  It gives me satisfactory results, though the puffiness is faintly there..  It does take a several minutes for the product to completely sink into the eye skin.  I do like the fact that it only takes a small amount to do the job.  I think the price is right for what I need.

Excellent customer service and Excellent product. Light, not greasy, absorbs quickly. I have super sensitive skin and have had no problems with it. Does wonders for undereye circles, jury is still out on wrinkles. Great product for the money, much cheaper than similar products I was considering.

reviews.t: This is the best product that has ever come my way
reviews.x: This is the best product that has ever come my way.  I wake up with puffy bags under my eyes every morning, but after applying this product my eyes are smooth and I look at least 5 years younger.  I don't need to use concealer any more and I will be a customer for life.

Been using this for about a month now. So far I like it. The skin under my eyes seems very moisturized and my make up goes on smoother. I'm very careful with sun on my face so I don't really have any wrinkles but I want to prevent and I think this is doing just fine.

reviews.t: I apply this cream about once a day to help ...
reviews.x: I apply this cream about once a day to help with my eye bags (sleep deprived). You only need a little bit when applying. It rubs in very smoothly and dries really fast. I've seen improvement with my bags fading and plan to continue using.

claims.text: Many reviewers report reduced puffiness and dark circles under the eyes after using the product.
Reviewers frequently note the product is non-greasy, absorbs quickly, and a small amount goes a long way.
Several users report improvements in fine lines, wrinkles, and crow's feet around the eyes.
Some reviewers mention only slight or partial improvement, particularly with lines and dark circles.
A few reviewers report the product did not work or did not meet expectations.
